scope: Super Campaign MID117 mutable daily-limit atomicity only
changes: Preserved existing campaign_sweep_op_id UUIDv4 identity, permanent MID117 receipt domain, RandomOutcomeService policy, and PlayerUnitOfWork transaction boundary.
Added a pre-transaction Super source-membership gate so campaign_type=2 cannot fall back to a Normal/fabricated row.
Added an in-UoW mutable attempt preflight after receipt replay and request/VIP validation but before cost validation and Campaign entropy.
Successful Super batches decrement daily_limit by exactly sweep_num after cost/reward settlement and before response/receipt staging, so the decrement shares the same atomic commit.
MID117 response.campaign now carries the decremented Super row; receipt replay continues rendering the current live campaign projection and consumes zero additional attempts.
Normal MID117 behavior and all OTA files are unchanged.
